user.title: Set up a hazard monitor
user.description: Pick the cameras of the area and the AI Task entity that will look at them. The integration does the rest: it analyses the images on a dynamic schedule, scores five hazard categories from 0 to 4 and raises an alert when the risk is high. With a cloud AI provider the camera images leave your network.

data_description.name: Used for the device and as the prefix of the entity IDs.
data_description.cameras: One to four views of the same area, analysed together.
data_description.ai_task_entity: An AI Task entity with image support (Ollama, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic…), configured in its own integration.
data_description.occupancy_entity: When it turns on, an extra analysis runs; while it is on, the faster schedule applies.
data_description.area_description: A sentence of context for the AI, for example: electronics lab with soldering stations and a 3D printer.

error.camera_count: Select from one to four cameras.

abort.no_ai_task: No AI Task entity with image support was found. Set up an AI integration that provides one (for example Ollama, OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic), then add Hazard Analysis again.

data_description.cameras: One to four views of the same area, analysed together.
data_description.ai_task_entity: An AI Task entity with image support (Ollama, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic…), configured in its own integration.
data_description.fallback_ai_task_entity: Used when the main engine is unavailable, fails or does not answer within 3 minutes.
data_description.occupancy_entity: When it turns on, an extra analysis runs; while it is on, the faster schedule applies.
data_description.workday_entity: While it is on (e.g. Workday binary sensor or a schedule) the faster schedule applies.
data_description.environment_sensors: Particulate, CO2, temperature, smoke or leak sensors of the area: given to the AI as corroborating evidence.
data_description.area_description: A sentence of context for the AI, for example: electronics lab with soldering stations and a 3D printer.
data_description.notify_services: Besides the persistent notification, send the alerts to these notify services (for example mobile_app_phone).
data_description.save_evidence: On a high or critical reading, save a snapshot of every camera in the Media folder hazard_analysis (kept 30 days).

error.camera_count: Select from one to four cameras.
error.same_engine: Pick a different entity from the main one.
